verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents an official CLI for managing tenant configuration, automating tasks, and integrating into development and deployment workflows, plus an "Agent Mode" for that CLI. It also offers a Terraform module for provisioning apps, APIs, roles, MFA, and SSO, and Client Credentials M2M auth intended for CLIs, daemons, and backend services, which together support headless, CI-driven automation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-interactive CLI authentication and CI pipeline usage (e.g., pipeline examples), detail on what Agent Mode does, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.
